messages:
maria (Support): Heads-up: ACME Demo Labs hit repeated 429s during a live pitch. They reported Retry-After: 60 on each response. Traffic spiked to ~180 req/min for ~2m; free plan cap is 60 RPM. Customer needs a short temporary lift for an ongoing demo. Can we do a manual burst/exception?

jess (Support): I'm pulling their account now — no unpaid invoices. Traffic looks single-key and very bursty to /v1/chat/completions. Do we have a standard temporary override policy? Also recommend they honor Retry-After and add backoff.

ops-oncall: Quick checks: confirm it's 429 not 401/403. Also check region routing in case they hit a fallback pool with stricter caps.

maria (Support): Logs only show 429s. No auth failures. Demo is in ~20m, customer asked for immediate help.

jess (Support): We can grant a manual override. Standard short lift we do: bump to 300 RPM for 30–60 minutes. Need sales sign-off for anything longer. Whoever owns the account should accept trial terms.

tom (Sales): I can approve a 30–60m burst + a 7-day paid trial if they want to convert. Need billing contact and account email. @maria please share contact info and I'll open the trial.

maria (Support): Org: ACME Demo Labs — contact emma@acmedemo.com. Account has no billing details set. Customer said they can accept a short trial but urgently need the demo to finish.

billing-bot: No outstanding invoices. Available promos flagged: trial-7d-50pct (requires sales activation).

jess (Support): Manual override applied: per-minute cap increased to 300 RPM for 45 minutes. Override ID OV-2026-789. Please validate on the client side (they should see fewer 429s now).

maria (Support): Customer confirms 429s stopped and demo resumed successfully. They asked for a note on the account so future scheduled demos don't hit auto-throttle.

tom (Sales): I'll propose a short paid pilot and follow up with ACME. Opening sales ticket and sending trial link now. Will CC ops and support on the convo.

ops-oncall: Recommend we send the customer a short engineering checklist: implement client-side token-bucket limiter, exponential backoff respecting Retry-After, use streaming or output tokens limits to smooth bursts, and batch embeddings where applicable.

jess (Support): Logged the override and summary in support ticket SUP-3542. Noted follow-up actions for sales and ops. Closing internal loop for now. :white_check_mark:

maria (Support): Thanks everyone — passing to @tom for sales follow-up. Reopen SUP-3542 if it recurs.
summary: ACME demo hit free-tier RPM limit causing 429s; manual 45m override to 300 RPM applied; sales to offer trial; ops recommended client-side rate limiting and backoff.
